sourceRecords.title: Ocean Winds Secures Third Celtic Sea Floating Wind Site
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Ocean Winds secured the third floating offshore wind site in the Celtic Sea offered through the Crown Estate Round 5 auction. The source states that Ocean Winds joined Equinor and Gwynt Glas, which had already been awarded rights for two other Round 5 sites.
